name: Bismuth (experimental)
description: iOS Metal-only visibility culling with Geometry Dash OpenGL ES shared-texture rendering; no GLES culling fallback.

ios_gpu_debug.name: iOS GPU assist debug
ios_gpu_debug.description: Shows resolved-state classification, dirty-state activity, GPU state uploads, and the current stock/GPU-assist status. Detailed probing adds diagnostic CPU overhead and should be disabled for normal play.

crash_diagnostics.name: Detailed crash diagnostics
crash_diagnostics.description: Writes renderer-stage and large-level progress breadcrumbs to Geode's native log and the mod save folder (crash-breadcrumbs.log). Per-object log spam is disabled; no second crash handler is installed.

ios_render_method.name: iOS renderer method
one-of: 18 - Triple VBO ring + CPU visibility mask
19 - Triple VBO ring + Metal visibility mask
20 - Triple VBO ring + no camera culling
ios_render_method.description: Select an actual rendering configuration. Five vertex delivery methods are crossed with four visibility methods. Takes effect when a new level is opened.
